text:
每件道具的属性终值这样算：基础值乘上（一加所有乘算之和），再加上所有加算之和。只有一个乘区：不管加成来自包体、邻接、信仰还是 buff，所有乘算先相加，再乘一次；加算在乘完之后相加，不吃任何百分比放大。

所以两份同样的乘算合起来是加成翻倍，而不是彼此连乘；加算前期强，后期随乘算堆叠自然贬值。乘算之和低到负一倍以下时按零算，终值只剩加算部分。单位级的标准轴是公式之外的最后一步，乘在道具级终值之上。中途不取整，只在落到血量或显示时才取整。

---

texts.en:
An item's final stat value is calculated like this: the base value times (one plus the sum of all multipliers), plus the sum of all flat bonuses. There is only one multiplier bucket: whether a bonus comes from bags, adjacency, Faith or buffs, all multipliers are added together and applied once; flat bonuses are added after the multiplication and are not boosted by any percentage.

So two identical multipliers together double the bonus instead of compounding; flat bonuses are strong early and naturally lose value later as multipliers stack up. If the multipliers sum to less than minus one, the multiplied part counts as zero and the final value is just the flat bonuses. Unit-level standard axes are a final step outside the formula, multiplied on top of the item-level final value. Nothing is rounded along the way; values are rounded only when they land on Health or are displayed.
